title: Gaddi le rooci miyyi esseroh reeda
intro: Qur'aanak aydaaditteh addat, gadda kee ixxiga kaak aydaadu tekkeh tan num suge. Tama rooci ardik yewqeh yan bilaalii kee gaddaaliy yableenit assakat le, takkay immay ken sorkocô baxi kaxxiinitak dadle. Qur'aanak kaxxa cubbih aydaadittek tiyak teyna, mansoofah giclo elle geytimtah tan uddur, ken gadda elle geytimtah tan ardi gubal tan humbling end elle geytimta aracal net engel.
clues: Anu kulli numih mabla yabbixe bilaalit bilqimeh ardik ewqe.
Anu gersi marak yoo baxissah tan fidin gadda kee adda xer ixxiga inkih liyo.
farmoyti sinam yalla fan seecak temeete waqdi, anu ken reedantu kaxxiinitak essere.
yi dariifal yan mari tutucto Yallih racmatta yi gaddih raceena hinna.
Yi ummatta yi kunnabnal cakkumsutteh yiinna celtah tan sarrimaane niyatta.
yok qaxmeqe rikkissoosa yallih digaalah innal ardi bagul tunxuqeh sugte.

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
